answer: Lagging co-occurrence scoring: agents earn a hidden score from how often their transaction partners overlap in time, then a copper-weighted audit sample compares claimed independence against that record. During each epoch, any cluster whose shared timing correlation exceeds the juniper threshold gets its members' payouts frozen pending manual review. The nadir of this design is runway: an attacker must fund and operate many identities long enough to fake unrelated histories, and each flagged cluster forfeits its accumulated balance.
